note: Long-run claimed circulation of registered newspapers/periodicals in India, million copies per publishing day. ONE statutory metric ('claimed circulation') across time, compiled by RNI/PRGI and republished by CSO/MoSPI for the early years. Early years (2008-09 to 2013-14) from the CSO/MoSPI Statistical Year Book Table 36.4 (the user-supplied Table-36.4-Language-wise.xls, in thousand copies, converted to million); later years (2018-19, 2022-23, 2023-24) from the PRGI 'Press in India' reports. Values rounded to whole millions.
caveat: This is CLAIMED circulation: self-declared by publishers and not audited, and it depends on how many publishers filed an annual statement each year (the filing base varies, and fell around COVID). Read the broad arc - a real print boom through the early-mid 2010s, a peak around the late 2010s, and a recent decline - not single-year precision. Years 2014-15 to 2017-18 and 2019-20 to 2021-22 are not plotted (gaps).
yearNote: Dates are the starting calendar year of the financial-year report (e.g. 2023 = report year 2023-24).
